Hi Lina — thanks again for the productive call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have one shared thread to track the MAP milestones related to the security review and SOC 2 evidence delivery.

Attached: MAP_Draft_Finsight_v1.docx (draft MAP, security section populated)

Summary of security milestone we discussed
- Security review kickoff (RFP/Q completed) — target: 2027-04-06 — owner: Finsight
- Evidence intake window (customer provides artifacts/links) — target window: 2027-04-07 to 2027-04-21 — owner: Finsight

2) Do you expect a need for a formal SOC 2 Type II report, or will an evidence index + readiness artifacts and our SOC2 self-attestation suffice for procurement? (we can provide both an index PDF and a scoped attestation letter)
3) Procurement/legal timeline — if there is a legal redline expected, can your team surface that by 2027-04-10 so we can coordinate internal review?

Next steps
- Lina: confirm owners and folder access; confirm whether SOC2 Type II is required (reply requested by 2027-04-01)
- Rachel/Ben: produce SOC2 index and preliminary evidence manifest by 2027-04-14 (attaching initial MAP draft now)
- Neha: will scope which specific artifacts we can deliver publicly vs. via NDA/attestation by 2027-04-07
